_source: Held item Basic descriptions — owned, hand-maintained. Transcribed from the English in-game held-item screen (grade-20 effect text, which is what the card shows at grades 20–40). normalize.py uses `description` here as the Basic tier and moves UNITE-DB text to `descriptionAdvanced`. Unique items without a still (Mega Stones, Rusted Sword) are absent and keep UNITE-DB as their only description. No script writes this file.

muscle-band.description: When basic attacks hit, the damage is increased by 3% of the opposing Pokémon's remaining HP.

scope-lens.description: Increases the damage of basic attack critical hits. The higher the Pokémon's Attack, the more the damage increases.

shell-bell.description: When the Pokémon hits with a move, it recovers a minimum of 80 HP. The higher the Pokémon's Sp. Atk, the more HP it recovers.

focus-band.description: When the Pokémon drops to low HP, then each second for three seconds, it recovers 12% of the HP it had lost.

energy-amplifier.description: After the Pokémon uses its Unite Move, the damage the Pokémon deals is increased by 21% for a short time.

float-stone.description: Increases movement speed by 20% when the Pokémon is not in combat.

buddy-barrier.description: When the Pokémon uses its Unite Move, that Pokémon and the nearby ally Pokémon with the lowest HP are each granted a shield equal to 25% of the holder's max HP.

aeos-cookie.description: When the Pokémon scores a goal, its max HP increases by 200.

attack-weight.description: When the Pokémon scores a goal, its Attack increases by 12.

assault-vest.description: If the Pokémon has not received Sp. Atk damage for 15 seconds, it is granted a shield that nullifies Sp. Atk damage equal to 20% of its max HP.

rocky-helmet.description: When the Pokémon receives a certain amount of damage, damage is dealt to nearby opposing Pokémon equal to 2.5% of the Pokémon's max HP.

razor-claw.description: After the Pokémon uses a move, a minimum of 20 damage is added to its next basic attack. The higher the Pokémon's Attack is, the more this additional damage is increased. When this item is held by a Melee Pokémon, this additional damage also decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon for a short time.

weakness-policy.description: Increases the Pokémon's Attack for a short time by a minimum of 2.5% when the Pokémon receives damage. This increase grows larger the more times damage is received.

rapid-fire-scarf.description: Increases your Pokémon's basic attack speed by 25% for a short time after three basic attacks.

drain-crown.description: Restores HP equal to 15% of damage dealt with Attack-based basic attacks.

slick-spoon.description: Makes damage dealt by your Pokémon's Sp. Atk attacks ignore 15% of opposing Pokémon's Sp. Def.

curse-incense.description: When Sp. Atk-based damage is dealt to opposing Pokémon, their HP recovery effect is weakened by 30% for a short time. The HP recovery effect is weakened for longer when dealing damage to opposing Pokémon with Sp. Atk-based basic attacks.

charging-charm.description: Energy is charged through movement and basic attacks. Dealing damage to opposing Pokémon while energy is full will deal additional damage.

resonant-guard.description: Grants a shield to the user and nearby ally Pokémon when dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. This effect goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

drive-lens.description: Increases your Sp. Atk by 1.2% when you knock out a Pokémon from the opposing team. Increases by half when you assist in knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team.

accel-bracer.description: Increases your Attack by 1.2% when you knock out a Pokémon from the opposing team. Increases by half when you assist in knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team.

choice-scarf.description: When a Pokémon hits an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack three times in a row, its movement speed will increase by 40% for a short time.

amulet-coin.description: For defeating wild Pokémon, Aeos energy acquired will increase by 100% and goal-scoring speed will increase by 10%.

big-root.description: Increases the Pokémon's HP recovery by 20%.

vanguard-bell.description: Inflicting a powerful hindrance on Pokémon from the opposing team restores 10% of the holder's max HP.

score-shield.description: While the Pokémon is attempting to score a goal, it is granted a shield equal to 10% of its max HP. The higher the Pokémon's level, the stronger the shield will be. The Pokémon's goals cannot be interrupted while it is shielded.

sp--atk-specs.description: When the Pokémon scores a goal, its Sp. Atk increases by 16.

leftovers.description: When the Pokémon is not in combat, it recovers 4% of its max HP every second.

exp-share.description: While the Pokémon has the fewest Exp. Points on its team, it gains 5 more Exp. Points per second.

choice-specs.description: Adds a minimum of 1 damage to moves when they hit. The higher the Pokémon's Sp. Atk is, the more this additional damage is increased.

rescue-hood.description: Increases recovery effect by 23% and shield effect by 23% when they're granted to ally Pokémon.

curse-bangle.description: When Attack-based damage is dealt to opposing Pokémon, their HP recovery effect is weakened by 30% for a short time. The HP recovery effect is weakened for longer when dealing damage to opposing Pokémon with Attack-based basic attacks.

tenacity-belt.description: When a hindrance is inflicted on the Pokémon, the Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def are increased by 28% for 3 seconds.
